detail: Best signed percentage response still says maximum although negative values mean decline.
action: Canonical proposal uses the minimum signed change for greatest decline, with an explicit window and selection rule. Retain original text; adjudicate before release.

source: Revised workbook row 59; paper Supplemental Table 2 RECIP_Category
detail: Source OR wording for RECIP progression conflicts with the original RECIP 1.0 definition, which combines volume increase AND new lesions. Source response labels also differ from RECIP-CR/PR/SD/PD.
action: Use criteria-specific result records and retain original labels separately. Proposed consistency checks use quantitative RECIP 1.0 and explicit whole-body volumes; reference https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9635677/.

source: Paper PCWG4 passages and Supplemental Tables 1–2
detail: The manuscript operationalizes PCWG4 using a simplified two-new-lesion rule and a fixed confirmation interval, drawing partly on preliminary PRINCE criteria.
action: Record release, modality, compartment, counts and confirmation evidence. Reconcile against the final PCWG4 table before enabling an executable classification rule. No fixed threshold is hard-coded in this proposal; DOI 10.1200/JCO-25-02834.

source: Paper Supplemental Tables 1–2 versus revised workbook row 11
detail: Some paper table text still labels early PSA rise as not true progression.
action: The revised model records early rise without prospective flare classification. Retrospective interpretation requires later evidence and its own date.

source: Paper organ-dose tables versus revised workbook rows 65–69
detail: Paper retains PRRT-derived reference-dose threshold language that the revised spreadsheet qualifies.
action: Preserve any chosen planning reference and source in treatment_plan; do not enforce kidney/marrow universal PSMA-RPT limits.

source: Paper NLCB reason list versus revised workbook rows 51 and 104
detail: Paper includes completed cycles under NLCB; revised workbook correctly separates completion.
action: Store course completion independently; do not infer NLCB from planned completion or first progression.

detail: Some role and analysis-unit annotations conflict with their definitions: dose-response-analysis-performed is study-level metadata, and dose-limiting-organ is decision context.
action: Preserve source taxonomy and document normalized record roles and destinations; priority is a source recommendation, not an approval or mandatory ingestion rule.

detail: A mean baseline NRS can be fractional; yes/no opioid use cannot establish absence of dose increase.
action: Use a numeric averaged score, instrument/averaging context, confirmation PRO links and comparable opioid dose metadata.

detail: PRO-CTCAE collection flags do not capture actual questionnaire items; 0–5 source range risks treating no-event as CTCAE grade 0.
action: Store repeated instrument items separately from clinician CTCAE events. Preserve source 0 only as an explicit no-event summary sentinel; validate term-specific clinical grades externally.

detail: PTLV unit-of-analysis annotation allows lesion and/or patient, although RECIP uses whole-body PSMA-positive volume; uptake changes are not synonymous with progression.
action: Use scope-qualified disease_burden records and stable lesion-level metrics; keep uptake metrics as supporting observations.

detail: The deployed MIDRC procedure_name enumeration restricts records to breathing support or chest radiation.
action: The existing MIDRC procedure_name enumeration is preserved. A source label plus coded identity supports other procedures; no unrestricted overwrite is made.
